Hindi शहर Borrowed from Classical Persian شَهر (šahr), from Middle Persian 𐭱𐭲𐭥𐭩 (štʿy /⁠šahr⁠/), from Proto-Iranian *xšaθram (likely through Avestan 𐬑𐬱𐬀𐬚𐬭𐬀 (xšaθra, “kingdom”)), from Proto-Indo-Iranian *kšatrám, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *tek- (“to attain”). Cognate with Sanskrit क्षत्र (kṣatrá, “dominion, kingdom”), and Parthian 𐭇𐭔𐭕𐭓 (ḥštr /⁠xšahr⁠/). Doublet of खाता (khātā).

s.g: Siam (former name of Thailand: a country in Southeast Asia)

ety.text: Compound of श्याम (śyām, “Siam”) + देश (deś, “country”). Influenced etymologically by Thai สยาม (sà-yǎam, “Siam”).
